- 11 public benchmark datasets reviewed. Only evaluation splits are requested (about 39 MB in total), to score the 1.7B-parameter attention ablation models trained on FineWeb-Edu (Addendum 1). - No prohibited-use indicators. MMLU includes security studies, virology and chemistry subjects as academic multiple-choice questions, scored Low, consistent with the earlier review of MMLU in project 65616. LC 2.7.

In the 65616 review, PIQA, OpenBookQA and WinoGrande were withdrawn by that PI for lack of a declared licence.
- PIQA and Social IQa are requested as third-party copies (baber/piqa, lighteval/siqa) that do not state their source. PG19 is the team's own Parquet conversion of the script-based release.
- No score above Low. The section score is unchanged.
